name: Vala’s Curse
body:
Your magic abilities come at the price of an oracular curse.

Prerequisite: Valkyrie with the vala archetype.

Benefit: You gain one oracle curse. This progresses using your valkyrie level as your equivalent oracle level. If a curse grants access to spells, 4th- and 5th-level oracle spells are added to your spell list as 3rd-level spells, and 6th- and 7th- level spells are added to your spell list as 4th-level spells. If you possess an oracle curse from another class or gain one later, your valkyrie levels instead stack with your levels in that other class for the purpose of your curse’s effects.
